ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, the input on the left is R(s), entering the first summing point; this input end is marked with a plus sign. The output C(s) branches from the right node into two feedback branches: one returns from above to the first summing point and is marked with a minus sign at that input end; the other returns from below to the second summing point and is marked with a plus sign at that input end. The output of the first summing point enters the second summing point, but the left input of the second summing point is marked with a minus sign. The output of the second summing point enters the block G(s), and the block output is C(s). Reasoning: According to the method, let the output of the first summing point be x, and the output of the second summing point be u. From the first summing point, x = R(s) - C(s). From the second summing point, the left input is negative and the lower feedback is positive, so u = -x + C(s). The block relationship is C(s) = G(s)u. Substitute x = R(s) - C(s), obtaining u = -[R(s) - C(s)] + C(s) = -R(s) + 2C(s). Therefore C(s) = G(s)[-R(s) + 2C(s)] = -G(s)R(s) + 2G(s)C(s). Moving terms gives C(s) - 2G(s)C(s) = -G(s)R(s), namely C(s)[1 - 2G(s)] = -G(s)R(s). So the transfer function is C(s)/R(s) = -G(s)/(1 - 2G(s)).

From the second junction, because the left input is negative and the lower feedback is positive, write u=-x+C(s). The block gives C(s)=G(s)u. Substitute x=R-C into u, then substitute into C=Gu and isolate C(s)/R(s).

推理：按方法设第一个求和点输出为 x，第二个求和点输出为 u。由第一个求和点，x = R(s) - C(s)。由第二个求和点，左侧输入为负、下方反馈为正，所以 u = -x + C(s)。方框关系为 C(s) = G(s)u。代入 x = R(s) - C(s)，得到 u = -[R(s) - C(s)] + C(s) = -R(s) + 2C(s)。因此 C(s) = G(s)[-R(s) + 2C(s)] = -G(s)R(s) + 2G(s)C(s)。移项得 C(s) - 2G(s)C(s) = -G(s)R(s)，即 C(s)[1 - 2G(s)] = -G(s)R(s)。所以传递函数为 C(s)/R(s) = -G(s)/(1 - 2G(s))。

method.method_draft: Treat each summing-junction sign as a branch gain and form a signal-flow graph. Compute the single forward path gain from R(s) to C(s): first summer input +, second summer left input negative, then block G(s), giving -G(s). Compute the two feedback loop gains created by the output returning to the first and second summers; both equal G(s) and they touch the forward path. Use Mason’s formula T=PΔ_p/Δ with Δ=1 minus the sum of loop gains to obtain the transfer function.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中 R(s) 从左侧进入第一个求和点，输入符号为正；输出 C(s) 从右侧取出后有一条上方反馈线回到第一个求和点，符号为负。第一个求和点的输出进入第二个求和点的左侧，左侧输入符号为负；同时 C(s) 还经下方反馈线回到第二个求和点的下方输入，符号为正。第二个求和点输出经过方块 G(s)，其输出为 C(s)。推理：按指定方法，把求和点符号看作支路增益。R(s) 到 C(s) 的单一前向通路增益为 (+1)·(-1)·G(s) = -G(s)。由 C(s) 回到第一个求和点形成的反馈环增益为 (-1)·(-1)·G(s) = G(s)。由 C(s) 回到第二个求和点形成的反馈环增益为 (+1)·G(s) = G(s)。两个环均接触前向通路，因此前向通路余因子 Δ_p = 1，且 Δ = 1 - [G(s)+G(s)] = 1 - 2G(s)。由 Mason 公式得 C(s)/R(s) = PΔ_p/Δ = -G(s)/(1 - 2G(s))。

claims.source: From the second summing point, the left input is negative and the lower feedback is positive, so u = -x + C(s)

claims.claim: The block relationship is C(s) = G(s)u.
claims.label: reasoning
claims.source: The block relationship is C(s) = G(s)u

claims.claim: After substituting x = R(s) - C(s), u = -R(s) + 2C(s).
claims.label: reasoning
claims.source: Substitute x = R(s) - C(s), obtaining u = -[R(s) - C(s)] + C(s) = -R(s) + 2C(s)

claims.claim: Substituting u = -R(s) + 2C(s) into the block relationship gives C(s) = -G(s)R(s) + 2G(s)C(s).
claims.label: reasoning
claims.source: Therefore C(s) = G(s)[-R(s) + 2C(s)] = -G(s)R(s) + 2G(s)C(s)

claims.claim: Moving terms and factoring gives C(s)[1 - 2G(s)] = -G(s)R(s).
claims.label: reasoning
claims.source: Moving terms gives C(s) - 2G(s)C(s) = -G(s)R(s), namely C(s)[1 - 2G(s)] = -G(s)R(s)

claims.claim: The transfer function is C(s)/R(s) = -G(s)/(1 - 2G(s)).
claims.label: reasoning
claims.source: So the transfer function is C(s)/R(s) = -G(s)/(1 - 2G(s))
